YAC over expected per reception (YACoe/Rec) leaders through Week 9 (min. 25 rec), using data points from @FantasyPtsData:

1. Jaylen Warren (+5.56)
2. Travis Kelce (+4.42)
3. Khalil Shakir (+3.19)
4. Drake London (+3.10)
5. Zay Flowers (+2.95)
6. Mike Evans (+2.89)
7. Parker Washington (+2.70)
8. RJ Harvey (+2.46)
9. Luther Burden III (+2.11)
10. Harold Fannin Jr. (+2.11)

"Expected" YAC per reception is what a typical pass-catcher with the same aDOT, designed target rate and contested target rate gains after the catch.

aDOT drives 47% of the expectation, designed targets 33% and contested targets 21%. 

YAC over expected is actual YAC minus expected YAC
